scripts.dev:both: sh -c 'web_port=${WEB_PORT:-5173}; debug_port=${DEBUG_PORT:-5174}; echo "Starting app on http://localhost:${web_port}"; bun --hot index.html --port="${web_port}" & echo "Starting debug on http://localhost:${debug_port}"; bun --hot debug.html --port="${debug_port}" & wait'
scripts.build: sh -c 'rm -rf dist && bun run build:data && bun run build:bundle && bun run build:copy-data'
scripts.build:copy-data: sh -c 'mkdir -p dist/data && cp data/daily.json dist/data/daily.json && if [ -f data/options.json ]; then cp data/options.json dist/data/options.json; fi'
scripts.check:web: bun run typecheck && bun run test:web && bun run build
